name: Sony BRAVIA KD-49X8307C
summary: Sony BRAVIA KD-49X8307C ships with telemetry, Sony ads and a retail demo. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This 2015 Sony set runs Android TV 7 with 1.5 GB of memory. It ships with telemetry, remote support and bug reports, Sony content, ads and recommendation shelves, and a retail demo. The list also covers preloaded help apps, unused Sony apps and discontinued Google services.

Everything is turned off, not uninstalled, so it is fully reversible. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. The phone and TV need to be on the same Wi-Fi, and the TV asks you once to allow debugging.
keep: Live TV, channels and the HDMI inputs (the Sony TV app)
The classic Android TV home screen, until you choose a new one
Sony input, Bravia Sync and remote services
notes: The home screen on this set is the older leanback launcher, not the one on newer Android TVs.
The voice assistant is only turned off if you do not use voice search or the voice remote.

faq.q: Will Live TV and HDMI still work on my Sony KD-49X8307C?
faq.a: Yes. The Sony TV app plays channels and HDMI inputs, and TidyTV keeps it on.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work?
faq.a: Only if you leave the voice assistant group on. Switch it back on in the app if you use voice.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
